a1_acceptance.control_rule: oracle paired 95% CI lower bound positive versus zero, noise, label shuffle and episode shuffle
a1_acceptance.seed_direction_rule: at least two of three oracle seeds positive and no seed CI entirely at or below -3%
a1_acceptance.signal_first_rule: Also report point estimates, task effects, seed directions and control survival. A strict miss limits the claim label; it does not automatically terminate ARB research.

a2_acceptance.fusion_main_effect: query versus direct averaged over both frozen representations
a2_acceptance.representation_main_effect: ARB versus sanitized legacy B averaged over both frozen fusions
a2_acceptance.superiority_rule: paired 95% CI lower bound greater than zero

architecture.arb: six by eight action-relevant relation/event tokens
architecture.fallback: frozen HC plus a zero-initialized reliability-gated residual over only the first 16 future steps
architecture.sanitized_legacy_B: six by eight current relational tokens with no progress, remaining goals, frame/episode identity, fixed robot identity, future action, P or T input
architecture.shared_hc: one newly initialized R3-size HC trained on existing train only and selected on fresh confirmation, then frozen for every A1/A2 branch

authorization.scope: Start successor A1 and standardized 2x2 in parallel, do not enter R4-B, continue ARB research.
authorization.signal_first_addendum: During early exploration, directional positive evidence, task/seed consistency and survival of content-destroying controls are primary. Strict numerical thresholds constrain formal claims but do not by themselves reject ARB or stop follow-up work.

conditions.a2_reuse: oracle_arb_query is the ARB/query cell; it is trained once and reused without selection

data.confirmation_rule: Collect new successful episodes from frozen candidate seeds strictly after every candidate index used by the existing dataset. Confirmation episodes may not overlap any existing train, tune or read_only_test seed or HDF5 identity.

authorized: run A1 oracle utility and standardized A2 2x2
continue all preregistered branches when one branch is merely threshold-inconclusive
forbidden: overwrite or resume the original R4 run

seeds.derivation: first 31 bits of SHA256('SSC-V7-M3-R4-SUCCESSOR-A1-V1|2026-08-13|' + role); frozen before new confirmation collection

training.budget_reason: The original 900-epoch run had a late best at epoch index 865 and missed patience by only five epochs. A fixed 1200 cap preserves the convergence rule without a redundant four-HC pilot.
training.cap_handling: Save and report the best checkpoint as exploratory evidence, mark the strict gate inconclusive, and continue the other frozen branches. Never silently extend the formal budget.
